This section provides a structural overview of Moltbook activity and participation:

- submolt-level traffic and concentration,
- platform growth over time,
- daily and weekly activity patterns,
- new versus returning agent dynamics.

```{python}
#| label: eda-submolt-eco-init
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from IPython.display import display

sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="muted")
plt.rcParams["figure.dpi"] = 120


def _bucket_dates_for_barplot(date_series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Normalize resampled date labels for ``Series.plot.bar`` / ``DataFrame.plot.bar``.

    Daily ``resample`` + bar plots can hit pandas' time-series bar path and raise
    ``ValueError: Must supply freq for datetime value``. Calendar ``date`` objects
    avoid that while keeping pandas plotting APIs.
    """
    if isinstance(date_series.dtype, pd.PeriodDtype):
        ts = date_series.dt.to_timestamp()
    else:
        ts = pd.to_datetime(date_series, errors="coerce")
    return ts.dt.date



submolt_stats = (
    data.posts.groupby("submolt")
    .agg(num_posts=("post", "count"), num_agents=("agent", "nunique"))
    .reset_index()
)
submolt_stats["avg_posts_per_agent"] = (
    submolt_stats["num_posts"] / submolt_stats["num_agents"]
).round(2)
total_posts = int(submolt_stats["num_posts"].sum())
submolt_stats["pct_traffic"] = (submolt_stats["num_posts"] / total_posts * 100).round(2)
submolt_stats = submolt_stats.sort_values("num_posts", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

print("Top 20 submolts by post count:")
display(submolt_stats.head(20))
```

```{python}
#| label: eda-agent-top-submolts-wide
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# one row per agent with top-5 submolt/count pairs.
# Build the long table first so this cell is order-independent.
agent_submolt_counts = (
    data.posts.dropna(subset=["agent", "submolt"])
    .groupby(["agent", "submolt"])
    .size()
    .rename("post_count")
    .reset_index()
)

top_agents = (
    agent_submolt_counts.groupby("agent")["post_count"]
    .sum()
    .sort_values(ascending=False)
    .head(20)
    .index
)

top_agents_submolts = agent_submolt_counts[agent_submolt_counts["agent"].isin(top_agents)].copy()
top_agents_submolts["submolt_rank"] = (
    top_agents_submolts.sort_values(["agent", "post_count"], ascending=[True, False])
    .groupby("agent")
    .cumcount()
    + 1
)
top_agents_submolts = (
    top_agents_submolts[top_agents_submolts["submolt_rank"] <= 5]
    .sort_values(["agent", "submolt_rank"])
    .set_index(["agent", "submolt_rank"])[["submolt", "post_count"]]
)

top_agents_long = top_agents_submolts.reset_index()
agent_order = {agent: i for i, agent in enumerate(top_agents)}
top_agents_long["agent_order"] = top_agents_long["agent"].map(agent_order)

submolt_wide = (
    top_agents_long.pivot(index="agent", columns="submolt_rank", values="submolt")
    .rename(columns=lambda r: f"top{r}_submolt")
)
count_wide = (
    top_agents_long.pivot(index="agent", columns="submolt_rank", values="post_count")
    .rename(columns=lambda r: f"top{r}_post_count")
)
total_posts_by_agent = (
    agent_submolt_counts[agent_submolt_counts["agent"].isin(top_agents)]
    .groupby("agent")["post_count"]
    .sum()
    .rename("total_posts")
)

top_agents_submolts_wide = (
    pd.concat([total_posts_by_agent, submolt_wide, count_wide], axis=1)
    .assign(_order=lambda d: d.index.map(agent_order))
    .sort_values("_order")
    .drop(columns="_order")
)

ordered_cols = ["total_posts"]
for rank in range(1, 6):
    ordered_cols.extend([f"top{rank}_submolt", f"top{rank}_post_count"])
top_agents_submolts_wide = top_agents_submolts_wide.reindex(columns=ordered_cols)

print("top 20 most active agents with top 5 submolts and post counts:")
display(top_agents_submolts_wide)
```

```{python}
#| label: eda-submolt-eco-pareto
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: Post counts by submolt rank with cumulative share of traffic (Pareto).
#| message: false

# Traffic distribution (Pareto / cumulative)
submolt_stats_sorted = submolt_stats.sort_values("num_posts", ascending=False).copy()
submolt_stats_sorted["cum_pct"] = submolt_stats_sorted["num_posts"].cumsum() / total_posts * 100
submolt_stats_sorted["rank"] = np.arange(len(submolt_stats_sorted))

ax = submolt_stats_sorted.plot.bar(
    x="rank",
    y="num_posts",
    figsize=(12, 5),
    color="steelblue",
    alpha=0.7,
    legend=False,
    title="Traffic Distribution Across Submolts (Pareto)",
    xlabel="Submolt rank",
    ylabel="Post count",
)
ax.yaxis.label.set_color("steelblue")

submolt_stats_sorted["eighty_pct"] = 80.0
submolt_stats_sorted.plot(
    x="rank",
    y="cum_pct",
    ax=ax,
    secondary_y=True,
    color="red",
    linewidth=2,
    legend=False,
)
submolt_stats_sorted.plot(
    x="rank",
    y="eighty_pct",
    ax=ax,
    secondary_y=True,
    color="red",
    linestyle="--",
    linewidth=1.5,
    alpha=0.55,
    legend=False,
)
ax.right_ax.legend(["Cumulative % traffic", "80% line"], loc="center right")

ax.figure.tight_layout()

n80 = (submolt_stats_sorted["cum_pct"] <= 80).sum() + 1
print(f"Top {n80} submolts account for ~80% of all platform traffic.")
```

```{python}
#| label: eda-submolt-eco-gini
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: Lorenz curve for posts across submolts (traffic inequality).
#| message: false

# Traffic concentration: Gini coefficient + Lorenz curve


def gini_coefficient(values):
    arr = np.sort(np.array(values, dtype=float))
    n = len(arr)
    if n == 0 or arr.sum() == 0:
        return 0.0
    cumsum = np.cumsum(arr)
    return (2 * np.sum((np.arange(1, n + 1)) * arr) - (n + 1) * cumsum[-1]) / (n * cumsum[-1])


gini = gini_coefficient(submolt_stats["num_posts"].values)
s_sorted = submolt_stats.sort_values("num_posts", ascending=False)
cum_pct = s_sorted["num_posts"].cumsum() / submolt_stats["num_posts"].sum() * 100
n80 = int((cum_pct <= 80).sum()) + 1
n_submolts_total = len(submolt_stats)

print(f"Gini coefficient (traffic concentration): {gini:.4f}")
print("  0 = perfectly equal | 1 = extreme concentration")
print(
    f"  {n80} of {n_submolts_total} submolts ({n80 / n_submolts_total * 100:.1f}%)"
    f" account for ~80% of all platform traffic."
)

arr_sorted = np.sort(submolt_stats["num_posts"].values.astype(float))
lorenz = np.cumsum(arr_sorted) / arr_sorted.sum()
lorenz = np.insert(lorenz, 0, 0)
x_vals = np.linspace(0, 1, len(lorenz))

lorenz_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"cum_share_submolt": x_vals, "lorenz": lorenz, "equality_line": x_vals}
)
ax = lorenz_df.plot(
    x="cum_share_submolt",
    y="lorenz",
    figsize=(7, 5),
    color="steelblue",
    linewidth=2,
    legend=False,
    label=f"Lorenz curve (Gini={gini:.3f})",
    title="Lorenz Curve - Traffic Inequality Across Submolts",
    xlabel="Cumulative share of submolts",
    ylabel="Cumulative share of posts",
)
lorenz_df.plot(
    x="cum_share_submolt",
    y="equality_line",
    ax=ax,
    color="gray",
    linestyle="--",
    linewidth=1,
    legend=False,
    label="Perfect equality",
)
ax.legend(ax.get_lines(), [f"Lorenz curve (Gini={gini:.3f})", "Perfect equality"])
ax.figure.tight_layout()
```


Tracks when submolts were created to understand platform expansion dynamics.


```{python}
#| label: eda-submolt-growth-timeline
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: New submolts per month and cumulative submolts (from submolts table).
#| message: false

# Submolt creation timeline
_rs = data.submolts.set_index("created_at")

try:
    monthly = _rs.resample("ME").size().reset_index()
except ValueError:
    monthly = _rs.resample("M").size().reset_index()
monthly.columns = ["month", "new_submolts"]
monthly["cumulative"] = monthly["new_submolts"].cumsum()
_mcol = monthly["month"]
if pd.api.types.is_period_dtype(_mcol):
    monthly["month"] = _mcol.dt.to_timestamp()
else:
    monthly["month"] = pd.to_datetime(_mcol)

m_idx = monthly.set_index("month")
ax = m_idx["new_submolts"].plot.bar(
    figsize=(13, 5),
    color="steelblue",
    alpha=0.7,
    rot=0,
    legend=False,
    label="New submolts / month",
    title="Platform Growth: Submolt Creation Over Time",
    xlabel="Date",
    ylabel="New submolts per month",
)
ax.yaxis.label.set_color("steelblue")
m_idx["cumulative"].plot(ax=ax, secondary_y=True, color="red", linewidth=2, legend=False, label="Cumulative submolts")
ax.right_ax.set_ylabel("Cumulative submolts", color="red")
h1, l1 = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
h2, l2 = ax.right_ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(h1 + h2, l1 + l2, loc="upper left")
ax.figure.tight_layout()

print(f"Earliest submolt     : {data.submolts['created_at'].min().date()}")
print(f"Latest submolt       : {data.submolts['created_at'].max().date()}")
print(f"Platform age (days)  : {(data.submolts['created_at'].max() - data.submolts['created_at'].min()).days}")
peak = monthly.loc[monthly["new_submolts"].idxmax()]
peak_month = pd.Timestamp(peak["month"])
print(
    f"Peak creation month  : {peak_month.strftime('%Y-%m')} "
    f"({int(peak['new_submolts'])} new submolts)"
)
```

```{python}
#| label: eda-submolt-heatmap
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: Posting activity by day of week and hour (UTC).
#| message: false

df_h = data.posts.dropna(subset=["timestamp"]).copy()
df_h["hour"] = df_h["timestamp"].dt.hour
df_h["dow"] = df_h["timestamp"].dt.dayofweek  # 0=Mon, 6=Sun

heatmap = df_h.groupby(["dow", "hour"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
heatmap.index = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]

# pandas has no DataFrame heatmap plot; use matplotlib.imshow on the numeric matrix.
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 5))
im = ax.imshow(heatmap.values, aspect="auto", cmap="YlOrRd")
ax.set_xticks(range(24))
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{h:02d}:00" for h in range(24)], rotation=45, ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(7))
ax.set_yticklabels(heatmap.index)
fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, label="Number of Posts")
ax.set(
    title="Posting Activity Heatmap (Day x Hour)",
    xlabel="Hour of Day (UTC)",
)
fig.tight_layout()
```

```{python}
#| label: eda-submolt-stacked-area
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: Weekly stacked post counts for top submolts vs other.
#| message: false

# Top submolts traffic share over time (stacked area)
TOP_N = 8
top_submolts = data.posts["submolt"].value_counts().head(TOP_N).index.tolist()

df_ta = data.posts.dropna(subset=["timestamp"]).copy()
df_ta["week"] = df_ta["timestamp"].dt.to_period("W").dt.start_time
df_ta["submolt_group"] = df_ta["submolt"].where(df_ta["submolt"].isin(top_submolts), other="Other")

weekly = df_ta.groupby(["week", "submolt_group"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
ordered_cols = [s for s in top_submolts if s in weekly.columns] + (
    ["Other"] if "Other" in weekly.columns else []
)
weekly = weekly[ordered_cols]

ax = weekly.plot(
    kind="area",
    stacked=True,
    figsize=(14, 6),
    colormap="tab10",
    alpha=0.75,
    linewidth=0,
    title=f"Weekly Traffic by Top {TOP_N} Submolts Over Time",
    xlabel="Week",
    ylabel="Number of Posts",
)
ax.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=8, ncol=2)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
```

```{python}
#| label: eda-submolt-new-returning
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: Unique new vs returning agents per week.
#| message: false

df_nr = data.posts.dropna(subset=["timestamp"]).sort_values("timestamp").copy()
df_nr["week"] = df_nr["timestamp"].dt.to_period("W").dt.start_time

first_week = df_nr.groupby("agent")["week"].min().rename("first_week")
df_nr = df_nr.join(first_week, on="agent")
df_nr["agent_type"] = (df_nr["week"] == df_nr["first_week"]).map({True: "New", False: "Returning"})

weekly_nr = df_nr.groupby(["week", "agent_type"])["agent"].nunique().unstack(fill_value=0)
weekly_nr = weekly_nr.copy()
weekly_nr.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(weekly_nr.index).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

ax = weekly_nr.plot(
    kind="bar",
    stacked=True,
    figsize=(14, 5),
    color=["#5B9BD5", "#ED7D31"],
    width=0.8,
    title="New vs Returning Agents per Week",
    xlabel="Week",
    ylabel="Unique Agents",
)
ax.legend(["New", "Returning"])
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
```
